title: Formulating Multistage Cutting Stock Problems as QUBO
summary: Cutting stock problems are of large relevance to a variety of industry branches. Here, we present a linear programming formulation for a restricted version of the multistage 2D cutting stock problem with Guillotine cuts and test it on published benchmark instances. After this, we derive a non-exact reformulation in quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) form via unbalanced penalization, which we show to have possible benefits in modeling the problem with usable leftovers.
